title: They’re All Doctors: Synthesizing Diverse Counterfactuals to Mitigate Associative Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring retrieval fairness using MaxSkew, MinSkew, and Normalized Discounted Kullback-Leibler divergence (NDKL) on the FairFace and PATA datasets, and calculating similarity bias (difference in expected cosine similarity between profession text prompts and images labeled as woman versus man).

Measuring retrieval fairness using MaxSkew, MinSkew, and Normalized Discounted Kullback-Leibler divergence (NDKL) metrics on the FairFace and PATA datasets to assess representational disparities across different racial groups.
